en: A black‑and‑white street scene in a European town, likely from the late 19th or early 20th century. Cobbled streets run between rows of 3–4 storey masonry townhouses with neoclassical detailing. A woman in a long dress and hat walks in the foreground, a horse and cart stand in the center, and another cart with a large covered load is partly visible on the right. On the corner building to the right, shop signage with German text can be seen. The overall appearance suggests a quiet bourgeois town street rather than a famous monument.
